title: har ghar me jashn aaj imame raza ka hai
body:
har ghar me jashn aaj imame raza ka hai
dunya me roze eed ye ahle wila ka hai
<<DIVIDER>>
mehfil me shor chaarsu salle alaa ka hai
shora jaha'n me aaj zahoore raza ka hai
<<DIVIDER>>
mujh par faqat ye lutfo karam kibriya ka hai
jazba jo mere dil me raza ki sana ka hai
<<DIVIDER>>
baazu pe baandhi jaati hai jo unki zaamin
nusqa hamaare paas ye radde bala ka hai
<<DIVIDER>>
laaraib hai wo gulshane jannat ka mustahaq
mad'ha jo jaha'n me ali raza ka hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kya poochte ho haal ataa shaahe toos ka
roze azal se silsila jaati ataa ka hai
<<DIVIDER>>
husne amal me mere jo taseer qaas hai
mujh par ye lutfe qaas imame raza ka hai
